x402-monetize 1.0.1

- Updated skill description for clarity on supported platforms, settlement, and security.
- Improved compatibility metadata; now lists Zo Computer, Node.js, @x402/core, @x402/express.
- Detailed built-in endpoints with pricing and descriptions.
- Simplified quick-start instructions, including new service registration command.
- Added clear Payment Flow section to illustrate per-request payment process.
- Revised instructions for extending with new paid endpoints.

Initial release of x402-monetize

- Enables per-request paid API endpoints using the x402 micropayment protocol.
- Supports monetization of existing Zo skills and tools, with pricing from $0.001–$0.10 in USDC.
- Compatible with the Base, Solana, and BSV networks.
- Includes quick start instructions for setup, deployment, and middleware integration.
- Lets users test payments using Base Sepolia testnet USDC.
